city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in New Braunfels: Texas Hill Country birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: New Braunfels sits on the Comal and Guadalupe rivers in the Texas Hill Country, about 30 miles northeast of San Antonio. The city grew up around German settlers and today blends a strong heritage with a fast-growing family community. Birth care here runs the gamut — from CHRISTUS Santa Rosa Hospital's Level II NICU and Baby-Friendly designation to freestanding midwifery-led birth centers and a growing community of birth doulas serving Comal County.
city_fields.medicaidNote: No — Texas does not yet have statewide Medicaid doula coverage as of 2026. Some managed-care pilots and health plans offer limited doula benefits, but most New Braunfels families pay out of pocket for doula support. Call your Medicaid managed-care plan and ask directly whether doula services are covered, or call Texas Medicaid at 1-877-543-7669 and visit YourTexasBenefits.com.
